title: Review of c45's dense sink-escape finding (fresh seed 93): the escape advantage reproduces in direction but is smaller (mar 40 escapes 21 of 49 caught bodies, 0.43, against 8 of 32, 0.25, at mar 0: 1.7x, not >= 2x), and the contrast in selection on distance per cycle between the escape and removal arms does not reproduce (+0.08 [-0.51, +2.9] vs -0.02 [-1.13, +1.47], n 7 and 12); Weak
summary: Re-ran the finding's own world.py (disc_dt 50) on fresh seed 93: arm S and arm I at mar 40, and arm S at mar 0, T=1600, with c45's fate.py, c00's extract.py and c00's mtips.py. Escape share of bodies caught by a growing disc: 0.43 (21/49) at mar 40 vs 0.25 (8/32) at mar 0, a 1.7x advantage (c45: 2.5x and 3.5x); a late cluster of overlapping discs (t 1385-1600, rerun/S/sheet.jpg) catches most bodies at once on this seed. Median distance per cycle of dividing rods: S 1.69, I 1.59, mar 0 0.46 rod lengths (c45: S 1.93-2.03 vs I 1.11-1.25), so the S-over-I gap is not reproduced. Rear tip advancing >= 2/3 of net: S 14 of 22, I 11 of 19 dividing rods, and every rod moving 3 Feret lengths translates (3 of 3, 1 of 1): translation reproduces. Gradients of relative descendants on standardized D: S +0.08 [-0.51, +2.88] (n 7), I -0.02 [-1.13, +1.47] (n 12): neither the I-arm cost nor its cancellation in S is resolved at this n. Persistent splits S 24, I 20, mar 0 23 (generation 4-5).

observations.M: out/S_fate.txt and out/S_mar0_fate.txt: escape share 0.43 (mar 40) vs 0.25 (mar 0); out/S_tips.txt: 14 of 22 dividing rods translate (rear tip >= 2/3 of net), all 3 rods moving 3 Feret lengths translate; out/I_fate.txt: D gradient -0.02 [-1.13, +1.47], not the claimed -0.32

seeds_run.result: partial: escape advantage 1.7x (claimed 2.5-3.5x); S vs I distance-per-cycle gap and selection contrast not reproduced

controls_run.M: rerun/I (no-escape removal arm) and rerun/S_mar0 (drive off at the same disc stream), seed 93

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; 7 dividing tracks in S, so the selection gradients are wide. In my own campaign (20261027T0000-c50-marangoni-spread-loop1, -loop2) the same disc environment with c45's ladder world gave mar-40 escape shares 0.57-0.80 against 0.21-0.25 with the drive off, which supports the escape advantage but is a different world and not counted here.
